# Ilya Papou — CV

> Personal CV of Ilya Papou, Senior Platform / SRE Engineer based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. Kubernetes platforms, cloud and bare-metal infrastructure, reliable delivery, platform security and agent orchestration.

The canonical HTML CV is the source of truth for employment history, dates, skills and project status. It is readable without JavaScript. YourOwn.Chat is personal R&D with a prototype, architecture work and local validation, not an employment entry or a claim of a production deployment.

## CV

- [Full CV](https://papou.work/): Profile, contact details, spoken languages, professional experience, technical skills and personal projects.
- [Professional experience](https://papou.work/#experience): Sirena-Travel, Sberbank, I-Teco, Freelance / Flant and the MTS Group internship.
- [Technical skills](https://papou.work/#technologies): Programming, cloud platforms, Kubernetes, delivery tools, security, observability, data and agent systems.

## Personal projects

- [YourOwn.Chat — Agent infrastructure](https://papou.work/#projects): Go Agent Host, kagent integration, local coding agents, Temporal handoff, Helm contracts and controlled release design.
- [Home Aeroponics — IoT automation](https://papou.work/#home-aeroponics): ESP32, Raspberry Pi, C++, MQTT and Home Assistant for watering, climate control and monitoring.
- [Zero-Trust Mesh](https://papou.work/#zero-trust-mesh): Tailscale lab networks, Git-managed ACLs and OPNsense segmentation experiments.
